component.name: coinbase-mcp-server
component.summary: MCP server for the Coinbase Advanced Trade API

description.p: coinbase-mcp-server is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets AI assistants interact with the Coinbase Advanced Trade API: account balances, order placement, portfolio and product data, 24 technical indicators, chart-pattern and sentiment analysis, and market-event tools, alongside an included autonomous trading Skill.

Warning: when configured with live API keys this software can place real trades and move real funds on your Coinbase account. Use read-only or sandbox keys during evaluation and dry-run mode before trading with real money.
The server runs over stdio (--stdio, for desktop MCP hosts such as Claude Code) or HTTP (default, port 3000 unless overridden by PORT).
Initial release: 46 Coinbase Advanced Trade API tools, 24 technical indicators, chart-pattern and sentiment analysis, a market-event tool, and an autonomous trading Skill.
